confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live price or listing checks. Restaurant and hostel anchors are the most stable, since they sit near the supplied island and regional comparables. Hotel anchors are least certain: the supplied Koh Samui hotel figures look high against general Phuket knowledge, so they were only partly weighted, and July green-season rates vary widely by area. Cocktail (about 3.0x beer) and wine (about 2.75x beer) use the beer ratio because direct knowledge of Phuket bar prices is weak. FX: the 14 October 2026 value was reported in search-result snippets of the RBA homepage and was not checked against the RBA daily table; no 15 October observation was found, and a 13 October RBA reading of 0.6961 was also reported.
comparable_city_reasoning: Phuket is treated as a Thai island resort market. Beer, coffee, meal and hostel anchors are set near Koh Samui and Kuala Lumpur, with Chiang Mai as the lower bound. Hotel anchors are a judgement blend of general Phuket knowledge and the supplied comparables, sitting above Chiang Mai and Kuala Lumpur but well below the supplied Koh Samui hotel figures.
